content: उपस्तरणम् .²1 Spreading out, scattering. .²2 A covering, garment; तद् वै ब्रह्मज्य ते देवा उपस्तरणमब्रुवन् <ls>Av. 5. 19. 12</ls>. .²3 A bed. .²4 Anything spread out (as a covering), a substratum (said of the water which is sipped before taking food) अमृतोपस्तरणमसि स्वाहा. Scattering grass (around sacred fire).
